class.name: RosMsg
class.brief_description: A dynamic wrapper for ROS 2 messages.
class.description: [RosMsg] provides a flexible way to handle ROS 2 messages within Godot. It uses [b]BabelFish[/b] to dynamically translate ROS 2 message buffers into Godot-friendly [Variant] data and vice versa. Fields can be accessed dynamically using [method get_member] and [method set_member], or via Godot's property system if the message has been initialized. To improve the development experience, [RosMsg] includes a utility to generate GDScript "wrapper" classes that provide IDE autocomplete for specific message types.

method.name: from_type
method.description: Factory method that creates and returns a new [RosMsg] instance for the given [param ros_type_name] (e.g., [code]"std_msgs/msg/String"[/code]).

method.name: gen_editor_support
method.description: Generates GDScript wrapper classes for the specified [param p_type] and all its nested dependencies in the [param p_dest_folder]. These generated scripts inherit from [RosMsg] and provide typed properties for every message field, enabling IDE autocomplete and better type safety in Godot.

method.name: get_member
method.description: Returns the value of the message field specified by [param p_name]. If the field is a nested message, it returns another [RosMsg] instance.

method.name: get_type_name
method.description: Returns the Godot-formatted name of the message type (e.g., [code]"RosStdMsgsString"[/code]).

method.name: init
method.description: Initializes the [RosMsg] instance to represent a message of the specified [param ros_type_name].

method.name: set_member
method.description: Sets the value of the message field specified by [param p_name] to [param p_value]. The value is automatically converted to the appropriate ROS 2 type.
